headline: CHC @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 3.68 at STL 3.52, with a projected total of 7.20. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (CHC -0.68, STL -0.71), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -1.39, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Andre Pallante has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alex Bregman, Iván Herrera, Alec Burleson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Moisés Ballesteros, Ian Happ because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
